every subset of a frequent itemset is frequent

questions.q: Which statement about RTGS in India is correct?

questions.q: Which of the following is the process used in a nuclear power plant to generate energy?
questions.exp: Nuclear reactors split heavy nuclei such as uranium-235 to release energy.

questions.q: Compressed Natural Gas (CNG) used as a cleaner vehicle fuel is mainly composed of
questions.exp: CNG is mostly methane, burning with lower particulate emissions than petrol or diesel.

questions.q: The Environment Impact Assessment (EIA) is carried out
options: Before starting a development project to assess its likely environmental effects
questions.exp: EIA is a pre-project study to predict and mitigate environmental impacts.

questions.q: Joint Forest Management in India involves
options: Local communities and the forest department sharing management and benefits
questions.exp: JFM (1990) involves village committees in protecting forests in return for usufruct benefits.

questions.q: A number increased by 25% becomes 150. What is the number?
Two articles are sold at Rs 990 each, one at 10% gain and the other at 10% loss. What is the overall result?
A can do a job in 10 days and B in 15 days. They are paid Rs 1800 for completing it together. What is A's share?
questions.exp: Work rates are 1/10 : 1/15 = 3 : 2; A's share = 3/5 x 1800 = 1080.

questions.q: What is the area of a trapezium whose parallel sides are 10 cm and 14 cm and whose height is 8 cm?
What is the largest number that divides 245 and 1029 leaving a remainder 5 in each case?
questions.exp: Required number = HCF(240, 1024) = 16.

questions.q: In a certain code, each word is first reversed and then each letter is replaced by the next letter. How is BOARD written in that code?
questions.exp: Reversing BOARD gives DRAOB; shifting each letter one step forward gives E S B P C.

questions.q: Find the next term: 100, 91, 83, 76, 70, ?
questions.exp: The differences are −9, −8, −7, −6, so the next is −5: 70 − 5 = 65.

questions.q: Poet : Poem :: Sculptor : ?
questions.exp: A poet creates a poem; a sculptor creates a statue.

questions.q: Which of the following is the odd one out?
questions.exp: Sitar, violin and guitar are string instruments; tabla is a percussion instrument.

questions.q: T is older than P but younger than S. Q is older than R but younger than P. Who is the third in order of age (from the oldest)?
questions.exp: Order of age: S > T > P > Q > R. The third is P.
